claims.claim_text: The indexed Amando Dalisay is probably the Filipino economist Amando M. Dalisay documented at Harvard before and during the early war years.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary Harvard article and an official Philippine institutional biography align on the rare name, graduate status, nationality, field, and wartime chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable, not confirmed: the exact name is rare and chronology is compelling, but the index supplies no middle initial, nationality note, service number, or second direct identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources place Amando M. Dalisay at Harvard in 1940 and record an economics M.A. in 1942; they do not state when or how he joined OSS.
claims.match_notes: The profile is deliberately qualified and Box 164 review remains necessary before promoting the identity to high confidence.

The index lacks a middle initial or second direct identifier, so the identity is not promoted to high confidence.
person_updates.next_action: The probable match has documented University of the Philippines and Harvard student affiliations but no identified employer or explicit Harvard-to-OSS transition. Review Box 164 for nationality, birth date, education, role, and recruitment chronology.
